hero.name: Alessio Brunello
hero.tagline: I design scalable frontend systems, lead team delivery, and fold agentic workflows into everyday engineering — with measurable impact on speed, quality, and UX.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a Frontend Tech Lead with over 10 years of experience on enterprise web and mobile products. At Bludata I own roughly 80% of the frontend: UI architecture, a shared design system in a monorepo, and accessibility (especially keyboard navigation). I'm also starting to contribute on the backend.
about.description2: I work daily with React and TypeScript. I treat AI as an engineering multiplier: Claude Code in agentic mode, shared skills and methods in the monorepo, code review, and automated tests (including Playwright e2e) so quality stays high while the team moves faster.
about.description3: I'm deeply passionate about artificial intelligence and stay relentlessly up to date: I follow the latest releases, try them immediately, and bring them into real delivery — beyond the hype, with concrete results. Open to networking and interesting opportunities.

points: Leading a frontend team of 2–3 developers; owning roughly 80% of the frontend across web and mobile products, focused on quality, performance, and delivery

impact.title: Impact
impact.subtitle: One slice of the work, told without confidential detail

case.title: AI-augmented delivery in the team
case.context: Bludata · cloud management platform · engineering team

problem.label: Problem
problem.text: We needed to speed up delivery on a large enterprise ERP without lowering the bar on review, testing, and UX — and without leaving AI as a one-off experiment.

approach.label: Approach
approach.text: We made Claude Code and agentic workflows part of the daily method: skills and conventions in the monorepo, internal courses and end-of-sprint sharing (~10 people, 1–2 hours), AI-assisted automated tests, and a Playwright e2e suite.

result.label: Result
result.text: Roughly 2× stories and tasks closed per sprint for nearly every teammate, with quality and review kept high; faster mockups and prototypes; an AI ecosystem that keeps improving.

teaching.title: Teaching & Sharing
teaching.subtitle: I turn AI novelty into skills people can use — and I share them with the team
teaching.intro: Beyond building products, I transfer know-how. I've already run internal company courses on AI, and at the end of every sprint we share what we learned (~10 people, 1–2 hours). Public courses I've completed are listed on my profile.

tracks.title: AI for everyday life
tracks.description: Hands-on sessions on using AI assistants to write better, organize work, research faster, and reclaim time — without feeling overwhelmed by the tech.

tracks.title: AI for development
tracks.description: Workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, and MCP: agentic coding, shared skills, effective prompting, and bringing AI into the delivery cycle. Strong internal feedback.

beyond.title: Beyond code
beyond.subtitle: Things that light me up when I'm not building software
beyond.intro: Work is an important part of my life, but not the only one. Outside of code there are curiosities, habits, and people who keep me grounded — and looking ahead.

items.title: Technology & gadgets
items.description: I'm passionate about technology in general: I like understanding how things work, trying new gadgets, and bringing them into everyday life in a useful way — not just collecting them.

items.title: Apple ecosystem
items.description: I love the Apple platform and use it end to end every day: iPhone, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and iPad — at home, for photos, and for work.

items.title: Electric mobility
items.description: I've been driving a Tesla Model 3 for four years and I support electric mobility. No preaching: when people ask, I simply share my experiences — without hate and without pressure.

items.title: Finance
items.description: I study finance in my spare time out of passion and personal interest: a way to understand the world better, not a second job.

items.title: Sports
items.description: I enjoy fishing and play airsoft on a team: two different ways to be outdoors, stay focused, and have fun with others.

items.title: Family
items.description: I have a wonderful family: I live with an extraordinary wife and a little daughter who is already much smarter than I am.
